subject: Convergent model change: timeline, customer notice & exception runway
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health - Partner Success <ps@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Convergent model change: timeline, customer notice & exception runway

Team —

We need to align on the operational plan and comms cadence for the upcoming convergent model change that consolidates the v2-chat and v2-emb families into the new unified endpoint. Steering asks below so we can finalize a customer-facing notice by next Thursday: 

1) Timeline: confirm final cutoff for the legacy endpoints (proposed: 2027-08-31).
2) Customer notice: who owns the public notice + a customer-facing FAQ? (docs + CS)
3) Exception runway: what criteria and SLA tradeoffs for granting extended grace periods to strategic customers?
4) Rollback/escape hatch: expected policy and who owns the decision path.

Quick context: Nimbus Health (cc'd) is on a reserved plan and will likely request a 90-day extension due to an internal compliance window. I want to lock product asks and the rollout notice schedule today so legal/partner ops can review.

Attachments: [Attachment: 20270614-notice-draft.md (md)], [Attachment: MAP-nimbus-202706-track.xlsx (xlsx)]

Can each function reply with: a) accept/reject on the proposed 2027-08-31 cutoff; b) named owner for notice/FAQ; c) proposed exception criteria (short bullets).

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health - Partner Success <ps@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Convergent model change: timeline, customer notice & exception runway

Karthik —

We can support the proposed 2027-08-31 cutoff with the following operational plan: 

- Week 1 (now): finalize notice copy and FAQ. Owner: Marissa (product comms) + Docs (Neha)
- Week 2: CSM outreach to top 20 strategic customers with MAP templates. Owner: CSM (TBD) / Partner Success
- Week 3–6: Allow exception intake via the exception portal; exceptions evaluated by Product + Infra + Legal.
- Cutover window: 2027-08-24 to 2027-08-31 (soft cutover: redirect legacy traffic to read-only; block new writes after 08-31)

Suggested exception criteria (high level):
- Customer on dedicated/reserved contract + active migration plan OR
- Documented regulatory hold that blocks code changes and certification (e.g., SOC2 re-audit)

SLA tradeoffs for exceptions: reduced latency guarantee (best-effort), no capacity burst promises, and temporary increased unit pricing for extended support. Legal should confirm pricing adjustments.

I updated the attached notice draft and included a short FAQ. See doc link and MAP worksheet for suggested cadence.

On failures/rollback: we need a clear escape hatch for the first 48 hours post-cutover (auto-fallback to a pinned compatible model family) — Priyom, can infra own the fallback gating?

—Marissa
Principal PM, Cloud API
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Convergent model change: timeline, customer notice & exception runway

Marissa —

We can own the fallback gating and rollout automation. A few infra constraints/asks: 

- Feature-flagged rollout: we will gate by account and by region. Need the MAP list in CSV by EOD Wednesday.
- KV cache migration: customers with long-lived KV caches need an explicit migration script; we'll add tooling but each customer must run it during their window.
- Exception intake workflow: propose INF-3221 (Jira) as the canonical intake + triage board. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3221
- Rollback hatch: automated rollback to compatible variant for the first 72 hours. After 72 hours exceptions must be manual and approved by Product + Infra lead.

Operational notes: any exception that requires infra changes (e.g., dedicated cluster pinning) will incur a delivery ETA and cost estimate. We should capture those as part of the MAP spreadsheet. Priyom

> On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 12:15 PM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> > We can support the proposed 2027-08-31 cutoff with the following operational plan...

From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Convergent model change: timeline, customer notice & exception runway

Thanks for the heads up, team.

Nimbus Health here — we appreciate the clarity on the proposed cutoff, but we have a SOC2 re-certification scheduled for mid-September which means our engineering/security teams cannot finalize a model switch by 2027-08-31. We would like to request an extension of 90 days for a grace runway for our production workloads.

Notes from our side: 
- We are willing to accept an exception on latency/cost tradeoffs for the extension.
- We'll need the MAP template filled by your CSM so we can line up internal tickets.
- If there is an internal form to request the exception, please point us to it.

Contact: Alice Wong, Sr. Dir. Product at Nimbus Health
alice.wong@nimbushealth.com | +1 415-555-0133

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Wong <alice.wong@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health - Partner Success <ps@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Convergent model change: timeline, customer notice & exception runway

Thanks, all. Quick summary and asks: 

- Timeline decision: tentatively keep public cutoff at 2027-08-31 but allow exceptions up to 90 days for Strategic customers with documented compliance windows. This is contingent on Legal confirming pricing/sla language.
- Owners: Marissa — public notice + FAQ; Neha — docs edits and SDK callouts; Priyom — automation + rollback gating.
- Action: Marissa/CSM to populate MAP-nimbus-202706-track.xlsx and share CSV by EOD Wed so infra can flag accounts.
- Intake: use INF-3221 as the intake/tracking board. Priyom please confirm INF-3221 is ready to receive vendor/customer requests.
- Customer comms: draft notice goes live pending review from Legal and Partner Success by Thursday 2027-06-17.

Alice: we acknowledge your SOC2 timing. Please have your Partner Success rep fill the MAP sheet; we'll treat Nimbus as a priority exception. We'll follow up with a short contract addendum template for extended runway options.

I'll log a short summary to leadership and legal after Legal confirms pricing changes. Thanks for the quick responses.

Karthik
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
